sources.name: American Whitewater North Fork Clearwater access chain
observations: Names Washington Creek Campground Access at Forest Road 247 mile 42.7.
Places access on the upstream river-right side of the bridge to Washington Creek Campground.
Identifies the site as the take-out for Weitas Campground to Washington Creek and the put-in for Washington Creek to Quartz Creek.
sources.limits: Describes the bridge-side access but does not publish a georeferenced landing toe or carry path.

sources.name: USDA Forest Service Recreation Opportunities record
observations: Identifies the campground as a Forest Service recreation facility on the North Fork Clearwater River.
Facility description reports river access along the full length of the campground.
sources.limits: The mapped Forest Service feature is a campground location roughly 900 feet south of the stored route point; it is not a launch point. The feature does not pinpoint the carry or landing toe.

sources.name: Google Maps satellite imagery at stored point
observations: The coordinate falls in the campground/approach area on river right, inland from the North Fork Clearwater channel.
The visible treeline and facilities do not support a precise landing or carry coordinate.
sources.limits: Visual corroboration of general site context only; no coordinate was derived from the screenshot.

sources.name: American Whitewater Lower Bungalow access warning
observations: Describes Washington Creek as a take-out camping access for the Bungalow section and distinguishes the adjacent Quartz Creek segment.
sources.limits: Secondary paddling source, used for route context rather than exact access georeferencing.

decision: Retain the existing point as an access-site anchor; do not invent a waterline point or claim surveyed precision.
